# Solving Water Scarcity & Ensuring Critical Minerals Security

### Innovative Technologies Enabling the Energy Transition

Our approach combines cutting-edge technology, unrivaled expertise, world-class services, and
flexible financing options to deliver complete water and process technology solutions that reduce
carbon and water footprint.

[Explore Our Solutions][136]

## What We Do

[Water Reuse & Zero Liquid Discharge][Water Reuse & Zero Liquid Discharge]

### Water Reuse & Zero Liquid Discharge

Recycling water and eliminating wastewater for discharge. 
* [Water Reuse & Recycle][137]
* [Minimum Liquid Discharge][138]
* [Zero Liquid Discharge][139]

[Critical Minerals & Metals Resource Recovery][Critical Minerals & Metals Resource Recovery]

### Critical Minerals & Metals Resource Recovery

Extracting essential materials, like lithium, and metals from water.
* [Lithium Extraction & Refining][140]
* [Metals Mining & Recovery][141]
* [Brine Mining & Salt Recovery][142]

[Industrial Water Treatment][Industrial Water Treatment]

### Industrial Water Treatment

Process of purifying water for industrial use.
* [Process Water Treatment][143]
* [Produced Water Treatment][144]
* [Wastewater Treatment][145]

[Desalination][Desalination]

### Desalination

Removal of salt and minerals from seawater to obtain freshwater. 
* [Membrane Desalination][146]
* [Thermal Desalination][147]
* [Hybrid Desalination][148]
* [Brine Mining & Salt Recovery][149]

## Sustainable Solutions for Industry

01 / 07
[Metals & Critical Minerals]

### Metals & Critical Minerals

Unlock the full potential of your resource with sustainable solutions for metals mining and
recovery, lithium and critical minerals processing and refining, and brine mining.
[Learn More][150]
[Energy Transition]

### Energy Transition

Powering the energy transition through water reuse solutions for biofuels, hydrogen production, and
EV battery manufacturing and recycling.
[Learn More][151]
[Manufacturing]

### Manufacturing

Achieve high-quality, consistent production while meeting sustainability goals and reducing your
water footprint through effective water management solutions 
[Learn More][152]

### Energy & Chemicals

Innovative solutions that optimize operations, reduce environmental impact, and enhance
sustainability for refining and chemical processing.
[Learn More][153]
[Technology]

### Technology

Solutions for microelectronics and semiconductor manufacturing that maximize recovery for water
reuse and minimize environmental footprint.
[Learn More][154]
[Food & Beverage]

### Food & Beverage

Reliable solutions to manage food and beverage process water for dairies, wineries, breweries,
edible oil production, and food processing.
[Learn More][155]

### Infrastructure

Desalination and water reuse solutions focused on adapting to a changing climate.
[Learn More][156]

## Who We Are

At Aquatech, we tackle the challenges of water scarcity and complexity by leveraging technology,
expertise, and financing to deliver comprehensive solutions that reduce carbon and recycled water
footprint.

As a leading global provider of water and process technology solutions, we help the world’s most
recognized companies achieve their sustainability and operational goals by implementing innovative
approaches for water reuse, desalination, minimal and zero liquid discharge, and critical minerals
recovery.

Our work catalyzes the transition toward a more sustainable future and showcases our commitment to
addressing water’s role in climate adaptation.

## The Latest from Aquatech

Aquatech newsrooms is your source for the latest news on all things related to innovative water,
wastewater, and critical minerals recovery treatment. 

[More News][157]
[Press Releases][158]

### Aquatech Announces Agreement to Acquire METICHEM, Creating a Comprehensive Middle East and
### Asia-wide Partner for Industrial Water Services

Aquatech has announced that it will acquire Metito Chemical Solutions ("METICHEM"), a UAE-based
leader in advanced water-treatment chemicals and operations & maintenance (O&M) services across
industrial, municipal, and institutional markets in the Middle East, North Africa and Southeast
Asia.

[Read More][159]
[Press Releases][160]

### Aquatech Acquires Koch's Direct Lithium Extraction Business, Integrating Li-Pro™ DLE into the
### PEARL™ Technology Platform

Aquatech has acquired Koch Technology Solutions' (KTS) direct lithium extraction (DLE) business,
integrating the Li-Pro™ Lithium Selective Sorption (LSS) technology and extensive Li-Pro IP
portfolio into the PEARL™ process technology platform.

[Read More][161]
[Press Releases][162]

### Aquatech Unveils PEARL™: A Full Flow Sheet Technology Platform for Lithium Extraction, Refining,
### and Purification

[Read More][163]
[Awards & Recognitions][164][Press Releases][165]

### Aquatech Wins Water Technology Company of the Year at the 2025 Global Water Summit

Aquatech has been voted Water Technology Company of the Year at the 2025 Global Water Awards, hosted
by Global Water Intelligence in Paris.

[Read More][166]
[Press Releases][167][Technology Insights][168]

### AECOM and Aquatech to Deliver PFAS Destruction with DE-FLUORO® Technology

AECOM and Aquatech have partnered to accelerate the deployment of per- and polyfluoroalkyl
substances (PFAS) destruction technology, combining AECOM's DE-FLUORO® PFAS destruction technology
with Aquatech's electrochemical expertise and end-to-end technology solutions and expertise.

[Read More][169]
[Press Releases][170][Technology Insights][171]

### QUA Inaugurates New State-of-the-Art Membrane Manufacturing Facility

QUA, an Aquatech company, announces the commencement of production at its new state-of-the-art
membrane manufacturing center in Pune, India.

[Read More][172]
[Press Releases][173]

### Aquatech and DataVolt Sign MOU Agreement for Water Cooling & Recycling Technology Cooperation
### and Services

Aquatech Data Volt Information Technology Company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for
water cooling and recycling technology cooperation and services.

[Read More][174]
[Press Releases][175]

### Aquatech Awarded Contract for Lithium Refining Process at Lithium Americas Thacker Pass Project

Aquatech has commenced work on the Thacker Pass lithium project, which involves multiple process
trains incorporating evaporation and crystallization systems for the production of lithium carbonate
(Li2CO3).

[Read More][176]
[Press Releases][177]

### Facility, Stratos

# We Simplify Water

H2O Innovation is a water solutions company dedicated to helping communities and industries solve
their most pressing water challenges. Guided by its mission to Simplify Water, the Corporation
delivers value through five synergistic pillars: Water Technologies & Services (WTS), Specialty
Products (SP), Operation & Maintenance (O&M), Water Infrastructure Development (WID), and Maple &
Agri-food (MAF). H2O Innovation provides equipment, chemicals, consumables, and long-term services
that support the full life cycle of water, wastewater, and water reuse. Every day, the Corporation
empowers its team with the resources and guidance they need to exceed customer expectations. By
integrating innovation and operational excellence, H2O Innovation has become a trusted global
partner for sustainable water management.

# We Simplify Water

H2O Innovation is a water solutions company dedicated to helping communities and industries solve
their most pressing water challenges. Guided by its mission to Simplify Water, the Corporation
delivers value through five synergistic pillars: Water Technologies & Services (WTS), Specialty
Products (SP), Operation & Maintenance (O&M), Water Infrastructure Development (WID), and Maple &
Agri-food (MAF). H2O Innovation provides equipment, chemicals, consumables, and long-term services
that support the full life cycle of water, wastewater, and water reuse. Every day, the Corporation
empowers its team with the resources and guidance they need to exceed customer expectations. By
integrating innovation and operational excellence, H2O Innovation has become a trusted global
partner for sustainable water management.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it

# Water & Wastewater Treatment Turnkey Solutions
* Water Treatment Plant (WTP)
* Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP)
* Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP)
* Wastewater Recycle Water Plant
* Sewage Treatment Plant (STP)
* Zero Liquid Discharge Plant (ZLD)

Apex Ecotech Limited stands out as a leading force in the water and wastewater management sector,
leveraging over 15 years of expertise to tackle complex water-related challenges with advanced,
value-driven solutions. Our core competencies include the provision and integration of advanced
technologies and comprehensive services in water and wastewater treatment, recycling, evaporators,
and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems.

Our dedication to innovation and excellence fuels our efforts to design and deploy state-of-the-art
solutions tailored to our clients' diverse needs. At Apex Ecotech Ltd, we are committed to shaping
the future of environmental management through our steadfast focus on sustainability, resource
efficiency, and minimizing ecological impact.

### Our Expertise

We specialize in total water management projects, delivering state-of-the-art solutions. Our
comprehensive approach, backed by in-depth knowledge and experience, allows us to design and
implement advanced equipment and systems. We focus on incorporating the latest technologies to
provide reliable, value-added, and user-friendly solutions in the industry and other establishments
for a wide range of applications.

### Our Commitment

We are dedicated to advancing environmentally conscious and carbon-neutral technologies and
solutions for global water resource management. Our commitment includes evolving and adopting
intelligent, energy-efficient systems while expanding and diversifying our efforts ethically. We
strive to be responsible and aspirational in our approach, ensuring high-impact results and
sustainable practices.

### Transforming Challenges into Opportunities

By leveraging innovative water and wastewater technologies and a collaborative approach, we
transform wastewater challenges into valuable opportunities that benefit the environment, society,
and the company’s outlook. This enables us to continually improve, explore opportunities for
operational expansion, and significantly alleviate the strain on freshwater reserves while
contributing to sustainable water management.

### Tailored Customized Solutions

We prioritize close collaboration with our clients, consultants, and stakeholders to thoroughly
understand and address their unique requirements. Each project is approached with meticulous
attention during the design and implementation phases. Our goal is to optimize capital and operating
costs, streamline operations, minimize maintenance and downtime, and ensure the timely availability
of spare parts and services.

## Highlights

#### 180+ Million Litres Treated Daily

Our state-of-the-art project facilities are processing over 180 million Litres of treated water
daily, ensuring clean and safe water for communities and industries.

#### 200+ Clients

We take pride in our strong relationships with over 200+ clients who rely on us for reliable and
sustainable water & wastewater management solutions.

Apex Ecotech Limited stands out as a leading force in the water and wastewater management sector,
leveraging over 15 years of expertise to tackle complex water-related challenges with advanced,
value-driven solutions. Our core competencies include the provision and integration of advanced
technologies and comprehensive services in water and wastewater treatment, recycling, evaporators,
and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems.

Our dedication to innovation and excellence fuels our efforts to design and deploy state-of-the-art
solutions tailored to our clients' diverse needs. At Apex Ecotech Ltd, we are committed to shaping
the future of environmental management through our steadfast focus on sustainability, resource
efficiency, and minimizing ecological impact.

### Our Expertise

We specialize in total water management projects, delivering state-of-the-art solutions. Our
comprehensive approach, backed by in-depth knowledge and experience, allows us to design and
implement advanced equipment and systems. We focus on incorporating the latest technologies to
provide reliable, value-added, and user-friendly solutions in the industry and other establishments
for a wide range of applications.

### Our Commitment

We are dedicated to advancing environmentally conscious and carbon-neutral technologies and
solutions for global water resource management. Our commitment includes evolving and adopting
intelligent, energy-efficient systems while expanding and diversifying our efforts ethically. We
strive to be responsible and aspirational in our approach, ensuring high-impact results and
sustainable practices.

### Transforming Challenges into Opportunities

By leveraging innovative water and wastewater technologies and a collaborative approach, we
transform wastewater challenges into valuable opportunities that benefit the environment, society,
and the company’s outlook. This enables us to continually improve, explore opportunities for
operational expansion, and significantly alleviate the strain on freshwater reserves while
contributing to sustainable water management.

### Tailored Customized Solutions

We prioritize close collaboration with our clients, consultants, and stakeholders to thoroughly
understand and address their unique requirements. Each project is approached with meticulous
attention during the design and implementation phases. Our goal is to optimize capital and operating
costs, streamline operations, minimize maintenance and downtime, and ensure the timely availability
of spare parts and services.

#### 180+ Million Litres Treated Daily

Our state-of-the-art project facilities are processing over 180 million Litres of treated water
daily, ensuring clean and safe water for communities and industries.

#### 200+ Clients

We take pride in our strong relationships with over 200+ clients who rely on us for reliable and
sustainable water & wastewater management solutions.

#### About Us

Water stands as the most vital resource for sustaining life, yet the unfortunate reality is that it
is being misused at an alarming rate. With the global population expanding rapidly, efforts toward
water conservation are alarmingly falling behind. This concerning trend highlights the crucial
importance of water treatment solutions. At **Aquacaresee Pvt. Ltd. **we combine smart strategies
with cutting-edge technological advancements to deliver innovative ‘Waste Water Treatment
Solutions.’ These solutions enable companies from diverse industries to adopt the right technology
for treating wastewater effectively.

The key features of our solutions set them apart: they are compact, require minimal maintenance,
come with plug-and-play functionality, and are designed to be easily transportable. Our treatment
plants provide a critical response to the pressing issue of water pollution, which today severely
impacts countless lives across the world.

Our state-of-the-art wastewater treatment solutions are tailored to meet modern needs, focusing on
efficient use and sustainable water management. As water pollution continues to pose a grave threat
globally, our solutions are a step forward in combating this crisis. Through innovative and reliable
systems, we empower industries to play their part in creating a healthier planet.

# Aquarion - your specialist for process wastewater treatment and water purification systems as well
# as reuse and recycling in our core markets.

AQUARION is a leading provider of advanced wastewater treatment and water purification systems,
solutions and technologies for the Oil & Gas industry, the energy sector and other process
industries. As a total enhanced EPC solution provider, AQUARION offers solutions to some of the most
critical water and waste water requirements such as produced water, seawater for injection, process
and potable water, cooling water, boiler feed water, spent caustic treatment and refinery waste
water.  AQUARION provides the best available technologies, high quality engineering, international
expertise and local know how from its operations in Germany, Switzerland, Italy, USA, UK, Norway and
Libya.

#### Aquasgroup Zero Liquid Discharge Systems

***“Send it down the drain”*** – Sound familiar? Times are changing fast. This common practice and
the lack of thought behind it is in trouble. In this article, I will explain why.

[Read More][74]

#### Green Manufacturing and Cost Effective Vibratory Deburring Recycling

**Clogged drains, high chemical costs and regulatory compliance** are realities that challenge
manufacturers when discharging waste water from vibratory deburring processes.

[Read More][75]

#### How to Select Your Next Parts Washer

In order to cost effectively recycle water, it is critical that the parts washer design makes
efficient use of detergent, thereby minimizing the amount that the rinse water needs to remove.
Enhanced immersion and spray over immersion designs provide the answer to most applications.

[Read More][76]

#### Process Rinse Water Recycling Systems are the Future of Sustainable Manufacturing.

**Most metals used in manufactured goods require some type of chemical processing** including
precision cleaning, passivating, etching, anodizing, electropolishing or electroplating.

[Read More][77]

#### The Advantages of Green Manufacturing in the Metal Finishing Sector

**Metal Finishing benefits society by making inexpensive metals durable.**

For example, anodizing, passivating and plating minimize or eliminate the potential for corrosion.
This translates to the reliability of things like electrical circuits, building materials, medical
devices , aircraft and automobiles. We need this, but we also need to safeguard our air and water
supplies.

[Read More][78]

**AQUASGROUP** offers Process Rinse Water Recycling and Metal Finishing Systems with Industry
leading ZLD+ innovation and an ongoing commitment to Green Manufacturing.

#### Aquasgroup Zero Liquid Discharge Systems

***“Send it down the drain”*** – Sound familiar? Times are changing fast. This common practice and
the lack of thought behind it is in trouble. In this article, I will explain why.

[Read More][74]

#### Green Manufacturing and Cost Effective Vibratory Deburring Recycling

**Clogged drains, high chemical costs and regulatory compliance** are realities that challenge
manufacturers when discharging waste water from vibratory deburring processes.

[Read More][75]

#### How to Select Your Next Parts Washer

In order to cost effectively recycle water, it is critical that the parts washer design makes
efficient use of detergent, thereby minimizing the amount that the rinse water needs to remove.
Enhanced immersion and spray over immersion designs provide the answer to most applications.

[Read More][76]

#### Process Rinse Water Recycling Systems are the Future of Sustainable Manufacturing.

**Most metals used in manufactured goods require some type of chemical processing** including
precision cleaning, passivating, etching, anodizing, electropolishing or electroplating.

[Read More][77]

#### The Advantages of Green Manufacturing in the Metal Finishing Sector

**Metal Finishing benefits society by making inexpensive metals durable.**

For example, anodizing, passivating and plating minimize or eliminate the potential for corrosion.
This translates to the reliability of things like electrical circuits, building materials, medical
devices , aircraft and automobiles. We need this, but we also need to safeguard our air and water
supplies.

[Read More][78]

**AQUASGROUP** offers Process Rinse Water Recycling and Metal Finishing Systems with Industry
leading ZLD+ innovation and an ongoing commitment to Green Manufacturing.

## We are Archroma

Archroma is a global, diversified provider of specialty chemicals serving the branded and
performance textiles, packaging and paper, and coatings, adhesives and sealants markets.

Headquartered in Pratteln, Switzerland, the company operates a highly integrated, customer-focused
platform that delivers specialized performance and color solutions in over **90 **countries.

Archroma works with over **4,000** employees in **42** countries and with over **30** production
sites.

[ Textile Effects ][155][ Packaging Technologies ][156]

## Textile Effects

From fiber to end article, Archroma’s Textile Effects division play a crucial role throughout the
textile supply chain, offering innovative solutions for pretreatment, dyeing, printing and
finishing.

Whether it’s casual wear, home textiles, automotive, or specialty technical textiles, we enhance the
aesthetics and durability, while prioritizing the well-being of both people and the planet.

Through our PLANET CONSCIOUS+ approach, we partner with you on your journey, helping you stay ahead
of industry trends. Together, we can build a more sustainable future for the textile industry.

[ Explore Textile Effects ][157]
Go deeper:
* [ Markets ][158]
* [ Innovations ][159]
* [ Solutions ][160]
[

### Casual Wear

As your go-to partner in casual wear innovation, we have technologies and solutions that will drive
value with enhanced functionality, eye-catching aesthetics and sustainable differentiation.

][161]
[

### Performance Wear

With the rising demand for sportswear, activewear, outdoor clothing and athletic apparel, we have
technologies and solutions to help brands and mills stay ahead.

][162]
[

### Home Textiles

As your expert partner in home textiles, you can stay ahead with our innovative technologies and
solutions that balances performance and sustainability.

][163]
[

### Denim

As the leader in denim innovation, we bring you the broadest array of possibilities in colors and
effects with the highest quality and sustainability.

][164]
[

### Workwear and Uniforms

Archroma has the expertise and solutions to help you manufacture workwear and uniforms that meet the
highest standards of safety and performance.

][165]
[

### Exterior Textiles

We bring our innovation and expertise to help you develop products that combine performance, market
appeal and meet regulatory standards.

][166]
[

### Automotive

As a pioneer in the industry, we partner with automotive brands and suppliers worldwide to deliver
high-performance solutions for auto interiors.

][167]
[

### Nonwoven

With our expertise, innovation and commitment to sustainability, we develop cutting-edge
technologies and solutions to meet your needs for nonwovens.

][168]
[

### Swimwear

Performance, the perfect fit, vibrant colors and high-contrast patterns are key in this segment, we
have the right solutions to help you meet the needs of consumers

][169]
[

### Formal Wear

With breakthrough dyeing solutions, we are transforming wool dyeing and finishing to make it more
sustainable and cost-effective for mills and brands.

][170]
Previous slide
Next slide

## Packaging Technologies

Across diverse sectors — from food and beverage, e-commerce, and luxury packaging to paints and
construction materials — we collaborate closely with customers to create tailored solutions that
address their toughest application challenges.

Our expertise in developing advanced chemistries helps deliver high-performing, sustainable
applications across a wide range of end markets, bringing color, protection, purpose, and strength
to everyday materials.

[ Explore Packaging Technologies ][171]
Go deeper:
* [ Industries ][172]
* [ Innovations ][173]
* [ Solutions ][174]
[

### Packaging

We support paper and packaging producers to develop packaging for **Paper & Board**, **Flexible
Packaging** and **Tape and Label** that are sustainable as well as functional by providing
adhesives, coatings, colorants, functional barriers, optical brighteners and process chemicals that
elevate the sustainable profile of packaging and pave the way for a future including bio-based
solutions.

][175]
[

### Tissue & Toweling Solutions

We provide coloration, process and functional chemicals, as well as food safe solutions – supporting
the development of superior performance, coloration and strength in tissue and towelling
applications.

][176]
[

### Wood

Advanced coatings that protect, strengthen, and preserve wood’s natural beauty and durability.

][177]
[

### Paints

Advanced emulsion technology for every surface – interior and exterior.

][178]
[

### Construction

Premium solutions for durable flooring, waterproofing, insulation, roofing and advanced mortar
performance.

][179]

## We are Archroma

Archroma is a global, diversified provider of specialty chemicals serving the branded and
performance textiles, packaging and paper, and coatings, adhesives and sealants markets.

Headquartered in Pratteln, Switzerland, the company operates a highly integrated, customer-focused
platform that delivers specialized performance and color solutions in over **90 **countries.

Archroma works with over **4,000** employees in **42** countries and with over **30** production
sites.

[ Textile Effects ][155][ Packaging Technologies ][156]

## Textile Effects

From fiber to end article, Archroma’s Textile Effects division play a crucial role throughout the
textile supply chain, offering innovative solutions for pretreatment, dyeing, printing and
finishing.

Whether it’s casual wear, home textiles, automotive, or specialty technical textiles, we enhance the
aesthetics and durability, while prioritizing the well-being of both people and the planet.

Through our PLANET CONSCIOUS+ approach, we partner with you on your journey, helping you stay ahead
of industry trends. Together, we can build a more sustainable future for the textile industry.

Across diverse sectors — from food and beverage, e-commerce, and luxury packaging to paints and
construction materials — we collaborate closely with customers to create tailored solutions that
address their toughest application challenges.

Our expertise in developing advanced chemistries helps deliver high-performing, sustainable
applications across a wide range of end markets, bringing color, protection, purpose, and strength
to everyday materials.

## About Us

## AUSTRO CHEMICALS & BIO TECHNOLOGIES

Austro Chemicals & Biotechnologies Private Limited is a leading Indian environmental engineering
company, established in the year 2011 by Mr. A Jeyakumar C Ranjith.

We specialize in cutting-edge water and wastewater treatment solutions with a strong focus on Zero
Liquid Discharge technology. Our expertise benefits a wide range of industries, including textile,
dairy, coir, latex, tannery, food processing, beverages and sewages for more than 10 countries.

[Read More][50]

#### [Mission][51]

To pioneer Zero Liquid Discharge technology with cutting-edge, sustainable water management
solutions. To empower industries through innovative designs that achieve long-term water
sustainability.

#### [Vision][52]

To lead the global shift toward sustainable water management with innovative ZLD solutions. To lead
the global shift toward sustainable water management with innovative ZLD solutions.

## Our Products

[zld]

## Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)

##### Key Features:
* Eliminates industrial effluent discharge through advanced treatment.
* Maximizes water recovery for reuse in industrial processes.
* Minimizes environmental impact and regulatory risks.
* Converts waste into reusable by-products/ solid residue.

[Read More][53]

## Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP)

##### Key Features:
* Treats industrial wastewater to meet compliance standards.
* Removes toxic contaminants, oils, and heavy metals.
* Ensures safe discharge/ reuse of treated water.
* Custom- engineered for diverse industry applications.

[Read More][54]

## Media Filtration

##### Key Features:
* Removes suspended solids and turbidity.
* Enhances downstream treatment system efficiency.
* Cost-effective and easy to operate.
* Wide applicability in industrial and municipal sectors.

[Read More][55]

## Micro Filtration (MF)

##### Key Features:
* Filters particles and bacteria up to 0.1 micron.
* Protects RO and UF membranes from fouling.
* Provides high-quality pretreated water.
* Ensures consistent system performance.

[Read More][56]

## Membrane Bio Reactor (MBR)

##### Key Features:
* Combines biological treatment with membrane separation.
* Delivers superior effluent quality for reuse.
* Compact, space-saving design.
* Effective against organic load and pathogens.

[Read More][57]

## Ultra Filtration (UF)

##### Key Features:
* Removes suspended solids, colloids, and microorganisms.
* Ensures clarity and safety of treated water.
* Ideal pretreatment for RO systems.
* Long membrane life with minimal maintenance.

[Read More][58]

## Nano Filtration (NF)

##### Key Features:
* Selectively removes hardness, salts, and organics.
* Balances mineral content for process water needs.
* Energy-efficient compared to RO.
* Suitable for drinking water and industrial reuse.

[Read More][59]

## Reverse Osmosis (RO)

##### Key Features:
* Removes TDS and impurities.
* Produces high-purity process/ drinking water.
* Scalable for industrial/ commercial use.
* Reduces operational costs with efficient recovery up to 95%.

[Read More][60]

## Ceramic Filtration

##### Key Features:
* Durable, long-lasting filtration technology.

Prevents liquid waste from entering the environment, protecting water bodies.

Recycles nearly all process water, reducing freshwater usage by up to 98%

Enforced by pollution control boards to meet strict discharge norms.

Cuts water and waste disposal costs by up to 90%, offering major savings.

Recovers valuable minerals and salts from wastewater, turning waste into economic resources.

Showcases corporate responsibility and boosts appeal to eco-conscious markets.

Safeguards industrial operations by reducing risks from water shortages and restrictions.

Recycles water on-site, cutting wastewater transport, fuel use, and carbon emissions.

Supports sustainability goals while fostering a greener industrial future.

Minimizes industries’ legal, social, and environmental risks from water pollution and waste.

### Desalination

As the global need for freshwater becomes more critical, desalination—the process of turning saline
water into freshwater—is becoming more important with each passing day. However, as vital as the
process is, desalination consumes a significant amount of energy. We’re here to change that.

requiring minimal liquid discharge (MLD) and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) for wastewater treatment.

As the global need for freshwater becomes more critical, desalination—the process of turning saline

## PX technology

Our revolutionary PX^{®} Pressure Exchanger^{®} is recognized globally as a trusted, reliable,
high-performing energy efficiency device.

[ Our PX Technology ][79]
[ Introducing PX Q650 ][80]

Our revolutionary PX^{®} Pressure Exchanger^{®} is recognized globally as a trusted, reliable,
high-performing energy efficiency device.

### Core technology

Our PX technology uses a ceramic rotor to efficiently capture and transfer pressure energy. By
making processes more efficient and environmentally sustainable, the PX can lower costs, save
energy, and minimize emissions.

### Operating range

Our line of PX devices is able to handle liquid, gas, liquid with suspended solids, and
supercritical fluids, and is ideal for a wide range of pressure ratings from low to ultra-high.

### How it works

The PX’s ceramic rotor acts as a fluid piston, efficiently transferring energy between high-pressure
and low-pressure liquid and/or gas through continuously rotating ducts.

### Continuing innovation

When the PX first entered the market over 30 years ago in desalination, it was an industry-changing
technology that made new treatment processes commercially viable. Today, many industries benefit
from this technology, and we continue to explore new applications.

### Best ZLD Manufacturer in India

# Welcome To Genviss

At Genviss, we offer a diverse range of expertise, spanning the fields of Energy, Environment, and
Engineering, all under one roof. Our in-house engineering consultancy and engineering division
streamline our services to provide you with an integrated solution experience.  **We take pride in
holding the title of ‘Best ZLD Manufacturer in India’.**

[ Our Services ][20]
[ Contact Us ][21]

#### Our Commitment

## A Cleaner and Greener Environment

Genviss leverages its extensive expertise in water management, coupled with a robust engineering
foundation, to deliver cutting-edge, tailor-made solutions aligned with your requirements, in
collaboration with internationally acclaimed technologies.

[ Work With Us ][22]

## 1000+

##### Maximizing the Value of Each Precious Drop

## Your Complete Water Management Solution Provider

Genviss is a versatile company operating at the intersection of Energy, Environment, and
Engineering. With our in-house engineering consultancy and engineering division, we offer a one-stop
solution for all your water and wastewater treatment needs, including Effluent recycling, Zero
liquid discharge, and Municipal solid waste management on an EPC, turnkey basis.  We achieved
recognition as the Best ZLD Manufacturer in India through diligent effort and dedication.

Our extensive experience in water management, bolstered by a robust engineering foundation, enables
us to craft cutting-edge, tailor-made solutions that align perfectly with your requirements,
utilizing globally proven technologies and partnering with industry leaders.

At Genviss, our mission is to contribute to a cleaner environment by delivering a comprehensive
range of equipment, technologies, and systems, spanning from conventional to state-of-the-art
solutions for water and wastewater treatment. Our expertise extends to both industrial and municipal
sectors, encompassing the entire spectrum of “Complete Water Management Solutions.” We also possess
in-depth knowledge in water network management, facilitating water audits and conservation efforts.

Our repertoire includes custom-designed solutions for Water & Wastewater, Reuse & Recycle, and Sea
Water Desalination systems. We utilize a variety of treatments, such as physico-chemical processes,
clarifiers, filtration, and advanced technologies like Membrane and Ion Exchange Resin to achieve
optimal results. Furthermore, we excel in biological treatment, effectively removing bio-degradable
organics and nutrients from effluent streams.

At GEnviss, we prioritize water economics and incorporate them into our bespoke solutions, ensuring
that our engineered systems align perfectly with your needs.

[ Connect with Us ][23]

## Genviss presents a full spectrum of comprehensive water management solutions.

We provide a range of cutting-edge solutions, including physicochemical treatment, biological
treatment systems, oil-water separation systems, and nutrient removal systems. These employ
state-of-the-art processes and technologies in collaboration with global leaders.

Additionally, we offer potable water systems using advanced Micro Filtration or Ultra Filtration
technology, complemented by biological treatment, whenever necessary, to meet WHO standards and IS
10500 requirements. Our expertise in water network management allows us to conduct water audits and
contribute to the conservation of precious freshwater resources.

 

**We attained the title of Best ZLD Manufacturer in India through sheer dedication and relentless
hard work.**

#### About ICSOBA

The International Committee for Study of Bauxite, Alumina & Aluminium (ICSOBA) is an independent
non-profit association that unites industry professionals representing major bauxite, alumina and
aluminium producing companies, technology suppliers, researchers, and consultants from around the
world.

[More Info][41]

#### Cooperation with IAI

International Aluminium Institute (IAI), the only body representing the global primary aluminium
industry, strengthens collaboration with ICSOBA as conference partner for technical matters.

This partnership will start from the 41st ICSOBA International Conference and Exhibition which will
take place in Dubai from 5th to 9th November 2023 with significant contribution from the IAI and its
members to the 15 Keynotes presentations and more than 160 technical papers.

[Joint Press Release (06/09/2023)][42]

#### About ICSOBA

The International Committee for Study of Bauxite, Alumina & Aluminium (ICSOBA) is an independent
non-profit association that unites industry professionals representing major bauxite, alumina and
aluminium producing companies, technology suppliers, researchers, and consultants from around the
world.

[More Info][41]

#### Cooperation with IAI

International Aluminium Institute (IAI), the only body representing the global primary aluminium
industry, strengthens collaboration with ICSOBA as conference partner for technical matters.

This partnership will start from the 41st ICSOBA International Conference and Exhibition which will
take place in Dubai from 5th to 9th November 2023 with significant contribution from the IAI and its
members to the 15 Keynotes presentations and more than 160 technical papers.

[Joint Press Release (06/09/2023)][42]

At Ion Exchange, we bring you total environment solutions – water treatment, waste water treatment &
recycle, zero liquid discharge.

Specialists in water and environment management for over five decades, we provide solutions
across industry, homes and communities. Integrating extensive process technologies, design,
engineering and project management capability, we offer total solutions with single source
responsibility.

We generate substantial and superior value for our customers, creating quantifiable benefits for
them through our comprehensive solutions which include:
* Purifying water to ensure safe drinking water for homes and communities, urban and rural
* Treating water to meet the quality requirements of any industrial process
* Removing pollutants from waste water
* Recycling and recovering water and valuable products for reuse
* Recovering energy from waste

## Engineering Water, Differently

Because every industry and process is unique, we believe effective water and wastewater management
must go far beyond standard, off-the-shelf component assemblies.

### Welcome to Ionic

Thank you for visiting Ionic Engineering Technology Pvt. Ltd. We invite you to discover how our
engineering-first mindset treats water differently — because every industry and process is unique,
effective water management must go beyond off-the-shelf assemblies.

### Engineered for Efficiency

Our core philosophy centres on designing value-engineered systems that drastically reduce your
facility's water and energy footprint. By analysing your process realities, we optimise specific
energy consumption and maximise recovery across advanced systems like reverse osmosis and zero
liquid discharge — delivering significantly lower life-cycle operating costs.

### Explore Our Solutions

From intelligent chemical dosing to complex wastewater recycling, we bring together practical
experience and a commitment to doing what is technically right. Explore our full spectrum of
advanced treatment technologies — and discover how we transform unique water challenges into
sustainable, economical advantages.

At Ionic, we treat water *Differently*.

We welcome you to experience Ionic's Difference.

## Engineering Water, Differently

Because every industry and process is unique, we believe effective water and wastewater management
must go far beyond standard, off-the-shelf component assemblies.

### Welcome to Ionic

Thank you for visiting Ionic Engineering Technology Pvt. Ltd. We invite you to discover how our
engineering-first mindset treats water differently — because every industry and process is unique,
effective water management must go beyond off-the-shelf assemblies.

### Engineered for Efficiency

Our core philosophy centres on designing value-engineered systems that drastically reduce your
facility's water and energy footprint. By analysing your process realities, we optimise specific
energy consumption and maximise recovery across advanced systems like reverse osmosis and zero
liquid discharge — delivering significantly lower life-cycle operating costs.

### Explore Our Solutions

From intelligent chemical dosing to complex wastewater recycling, we bring together practical
experience and a commitment to doing what is technically right. Explore our full spectrum of
advanced treatment technologies — and discover how we transform unique water challenges into
sustainable, economical advantages.

At Ionic, we treat water *Differently*.

We welcome you to experience Ionic's Difference.

[Airflow Dryer (1)]

Products

Airflow Dryer
* Jiangsu Zongheng's MQG Airflow Dryer employs high-speed hot air to suspend and fluidize the
  material. By utilizing impulse airflow generated from precisely varied tube diameters, it
  continuously tumbles the particles while conveying them. This design ensures rapid, uniform, and
  efficient drying throughout the entire transportation process within the system.

[ view more ][148]
[Falling Film Evaporation Plant 1]

Products

Falling Film Evaporation Plant
* A falling film evaporator efficiently concentrates heat-sensitive liquids. The feed liquid forms a
  thin film flowing down heated vertical tubes, where it partially evaporates. Vapor generated flows
  parallel to the liquid, enhancing the process. It ensures a short residence time and low operating
  temperature, preserving product quality. The system requires proper liquid distribution and
  complete surface wetting to prevent fouling and maintain high thermal efficiency and operational
  stability.

## What we do**About Us**

Jiangsu Zongheng Concentrating and Drying Equipment Co., Ltd formerly Yixing Yangxi Light Industry
Machinery Factory), founded in 1992, is located in Zhoutie Town, Yixing City, on the shores of the
beautiful Taihu Lake. The company covers an area of over 54,000 square meters, with a production
workshop area of over 22,000 square meters.

Jiangsu Zongheng is a modern high-tech enterprise specializing in the manufacturing of
concentration, drying, starch industry, alcohol DDGS, and Category III medium & low-pressure vessel
equipment. It is currently a member enterprise of the China Starch and Alcohol Association. Its
products are widely used in industries such as food fermentation, alcohol, chemical, pharmaceutical,
environmental protection, and petrochemical.

[Airflow Dryer (1)]

Products

Airflow Dryer
* Jiangsu Zongheng's MQG Airflow Dryer employs high-speed hot air to suspend and fluidize the
  material. By utilizing impulse airflow generated from precisely varied tube diameters, it
  continuously tumbles the particles while conveying them. This design ensures rapid, uniform, and
  efficient drying throughout the entire transportation process within the system.

[Falling Film Evaporation Plant 1]

Products

Falling Film Evaporation Plant
* A falling film evaporator efficiently concentrates heat-sensitive liquids. The feed liquid forms a
  thin film flowing down heated vertical tubes, where it partially evaporates. Vapor generated flows
  parallel to the liquid, enhancing the process. It ensures a short residence time and low operating
  temperature, preserving product quality. The system requires proper liquid distribution and
  complete surface wetting to prevent fouling and maintain high thermal efficiency and operational
  stability.

## What we do**About Us**

Jiangsu Zongheng Concentrating and Drying Equipment Co., Ltd formerly Yixing Yangxi Light Industry
Machinery Factory), founded in 1992, is located in Zhoutie Town, Yixing City, on the shores of the
beautiful Taihu Lake. The company covers an area of over 54,000 square meters, with a production
workshop area of over 22,000 square meters.

Jiangsu Zongheng is a modern high-tech enterprise specializing in the manufacturing of
concentration, drying, starch industry, alcohol DDGS, and Category III medium & low-pressure vessel
equipment. It is currently a member enterprise of the China Starch and Alcohol Association. Its
products are widely used in industries such as food fermentation, alcohol, chemical, pharmaceutical,
environmental protection, and petrochemical.

**A compact reflow oven fuses the solder paste, locking components onto your PCB with a flawless
finish.**

Our stencil printer lays down perfectly even solder paste every time. The rigid frame and PCB
placement mean crisp pads and consistent joints, whether you’re assembling a single prototype or a
short production run.

ensures sub-0.1 mm repeatability with effortless setup.

# Environmental Solutions for Dairy

## Our Mission

Reduce the environmental footprint of dairy and make it economically viable to do so.

## Our Priorities

1

Manure-Based Products

2

Environmental Markets

3

Innovative Solutions

## Advancing Sustainability Through Technology Evaluations

Learn how Newtrient’s comprehensive technology evaluations are uncovering the potential of
innovative technologies to reduce dairy’s environmental footprint.

## Featured Content

#### News: Newtrient to Provide Technical Assistance for $46 Million DFA AMP Grant

#### Blog: Newtrient Completes USDA-NRCS Conservation Innovation Grant to Advance Sustainable Dairy
#### Manure Management

#### DSWR Progress Update for 2025 Now Available

Dairy Farmers of America (DFA) has been awarded $46 million through USDA’s Advancing Markets for
Producers (AMP) program to coordinate conservation practice implementation across its farmer-owner
farms. As a program partner, Newtrient is providing technical assistance to participating farms
throughout the two-year program including on-site assessments, data collection, and practice
selection. Newtrient will also support the implementation of manure management technologies for
those farms that choose to focus on that practice. 

[See More][24]

Newtrient has completed a multi-year, nationwide evaluation of 15 dairy manure treatment
technologies and practices. This work is supported by the USDA’s Natural Resources Conservation
Service (NRCS) through its Conservation Innovation Grants (CIG) funding. The project assessed each
technology for effectiveness, practicality, and environmental impact, with a focus on improving
water quality.

[See More][25]

The Dairy Soil & Water Regeneration (DSWR) project team has released its Progress Update for 2025.
The report presents the status of the main tasks in the framework of the eight-year multistate
project — baseline data collection, field trials, and outreach and modeling — and looks at metrics,
findings to date for each research team and key takeaways. This past year marked the completion of
field work in multiple extensive trials and the beginning of comprehensive data analysis in the
project, which began in 2021.

[See More][26]

# Environmental Solutions for Dairy

## Our Mission

Reduce the environmental footprint of dairy and make it economically viable to do so.

## Our Priorities

1

Manure-Based Products

2

Environmental Markets

3

Innovative Solutions

## Advancing Sustainability Through Technology Evaluations

Learn how Newtrient’s comprehensive technology evaluations are uncovering the potential of
innovative technologies to reduce dairy’s environmental footprint.

## Featured Content

#### News: Newtrient to Provide Technical Assistance for $46 Million DFA AMP Grant

#### Blog: Newtrient Completes USDA-NRCS Conservation Innovation Grant to Advance Sustainable Dairy
#### Manure Management

#### DSWR Progress Update for 2025 Now Available

Dairy Farmers of America (DFA) has been awarded $46 million through USDA’s Advancing Markets for
Producers (AMP) program to coordinate conservation practice implementation across its farmer-owner
farms. As a program partner, Newtrient is providing technical assistance to participating farms
throughout the two-year program including on-site assessments, data collection, and practice
selection. Newtrient will also support the implementation of manure management technologies for
those farms that choose to focus on that practice. 

[See More][24]

Newtrient has completed a multi-year, nationwide evaluation of 15 dairy manure treatment
technologies and practices. This work is supported by the USDA’s Natural Resources Conservation
Service (NRCS) through its Conservation Innovation Grants (CIG) funding. The project assessed each
technology for effectiveness, practicality, and environmental impact, with a focus on improving
water quality.

[See More][25]

The Dairy Soil & Water Regeneration (DSWR) project team has released its Progress Update for 2025.
The report presents the status of the main tasks in the framework of the eight-year multistate
project — baseline data collection, field trials, and outreach and modeling — and looks at metrics,
findings to date for each research team and key takeaways. This past year marked the completion of
field work in multiple extensive trials and the beginning of comprehensive data analysis in the
project, which began in 2021.

[See More][26]

## Case Studies & Success Stories

## Pharmaceutical Industry: Active Compound Recovery

**Challenge:** A leading pharmaceutical manufacturer faced challenges in recovering valuable active
compounds from their wastewater streams, impacting both cost and environmental compliance.

**Solution:** Permionics implemented a multi-phase membrane system tailored to recover medical
compounds efficiently while maintaining product quality.

**Outcome:** The solution led to significant cost savings, improved product quality, and enhanced
water recovery, contributing to sustainable operations.

[ Read Full Case Study ][107]

## Solar Wafer Manufacturing: Complete Water Management

**Challenge:** India’s largest solar wafer manufacturing plant required a comprehensive water
management solution to support its water-intensive processes and sustainability objectives.

**Solution:** Permionics implemented a complete water management system, including the production of
ultrapure water and a Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plant, to meet the facility’s stringent
requirements.

**Outcome:** The solution enhanced operational efficiency, ensured regulatory compliance, and
significantly reduced the plant’s environmental footprint.

[ Read Full Case Study ][108]

## Nutraceutical Production: Spirulina Algae Extraction

**Challenge:** A nutraceutical company aimed to efficiently extract high-quality bio-compounds from
Spirulina algae for use in health supplements.

**Solution:** Permionics developed a custom-designed, multi-membrane process system incorporating
microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis technologies.

**Outcome:** The innovative solution enabled the production of high-purity extracts, improved yield,
and reduced processing costs, supporting the company’s commitment to quality and sustainability.

[ Read Full Case Study ][109]

## Pharmaceutical & Herbal Extracts: Sustainable Wastewater Management

**Challenge:** A reputed pharmaceutical and herbal extracts company needed an effective wastewater
management system to reduce environmental impact and comply with regulations.

**Solution:** Permionics designed a cost-effective membrane system tailored to the client’s specific
needs, focusing on efficient effluent treatment and water recovery.

**Outcome:** The implementation resulted in improved wastewater management, significant water
recovery, regulatory compliance, and cost savings, aligning with the company’s sustainability goals.

## Case Studies & Success Stories

## Pharmaceutical Industry: Active Compound Recovery

**Challenge:** A leading pharmaceutical manufacturer faced challenges in recovering valuable active
compounds from their wastewater streams, impacting both cost and environmental compliance.

**Solution:** Permionics implemented a multi-phase membrane system tailored to recover medical
compounds efficiently while maintaining product quality.

**Outcome:** The solution led to significant cost savings, improved product quality, and enhanced
water recovery, contributing to sustainable operations.

[ Read Full Case Study ][107]

## Solar Wafer Manufacturing: Complete Water Management

**Challenge:** India’s largest solar wafer manufacturing plant required a comprehensive water
management solution to support its water-intensive processes and sustainability objectives.

**Solution:** Permionics implemented a complete water management system, including the production of
ultrapure water and a Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plant, to meet the facility’s stringent
requirements.

**Outcome:** The solution enhanced operational efficiency, ensured regulatory compliance, and
significantly reduced the plant’s environmental footprint.

[ Read Full Case Study ][108]

## Nutraceutical Production: Spirulina Algae Extraction

**Challenge:** A nutraceutical company aimed to efficiently extract high-quality bio-compounds from
Spirulina algae for use in health supplements.

**Solution:** Permionics developed a custom-designed, multi-membrane process system incorporating
microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis technologies.

**Outcome:** The innovative solution enabled the production of high-purity extracts, improved yield,
and reduced processing costs, supporting the company’s commitment to quality and sustainability.

[ Read Full Case Study ][109]

## Pharmaceutical & Herbal Extracts: Sustainable Wastewater Management

**Challenge:** A reputed pharmaceutical and herbal extracts company needed an effective wastewater
management system to reduce environmental impact and comply with regulations.

**Solution:** Permionics designed a cost-effective membrane system tailored to the client’s specific
needs, focusing on efficient effluent treatment and water recovery.

**Outcome:** The implementation resulted in improved wastewater management, significant water
recovery, regulatory compliance, and cost savings, aligning with the company’s sustainability goals.

###### Patented Technologies

Our key Patents
[Spent Wash Dryer][159] [Raj MudX][160] [Biogas Upgradation][161] [NCELT Falling Film Evaporation
System][162]

## Spent Wash Dryer

At Raj Process we have developed a patented Spent Wash Dryer technology that sets a new benchmark in
sustainable waste management for distilleries and sugar industries. Designed to comply with the
strictest Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) norms, our innovative solution transforms bio-methanated
concentrated spent wash into a nutrient-rich dry powder that can be reused, sold, or repurposed.
Environmental compliance is at the heart of this technology.

[Read More →][163]
[Spent Wash Dryer]

## Raj MudX – PressMud BioDigester

RAJ MUD X is an innovative CSTR-type biodigester developed by Raj Process Equipments & Systems Pvt.
Ltd., designed specifically to convert sugarcane press mud into renewable biogas.

At the heart of RAJ MUD X lies a Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) equipped with a central
agitator supported by lateral agitators... resulting in faster decomposition rates and optimized
biogas production efficiency.

[Read More →][164]
[Raj MudX – PressMud BioDigester]

## Biogas Upgradation and Purification

At Raj Process Equipments & Systems Pvt. Ltd., we are redefining the future of renewable energy with
our patented biogas upgradation and purification technology.

Our process is based on a multi-stage cleaning and purification technology engineered for maximum
methane recovery and minimal energy consumption.

Backed by Raj Process’s in-house engineering, fabrication, and EPC expertise, our biogas upgradation
plants are fully automated.

[Read More →][165]
[Biogas Upgradation and Purification]

## Non-Clog Extra Long Tube Falling Film Evaporation System

At Raj Process Equipments & Systems Pvt. Ltd., we are proud to introduce our patented Non-Clog Extra
Long Tube Falling Film Evaporation System.

Traditional falling film evaporators often struggle with feedstocks such as distillery spent wash.

This patented technology is widely used in distilleries, sugar mills, agro-residue processing
plants, starch industries, chemicals, and effluent treatment facilities.

[Read More →][166]
[Non-Clog Falling Film Evaporation System]

System][162]

## Spent Wash Dryer

At Raj Process we have developed a patented Spent Wash Dryer technology that sets a new benchmark in
sustainable waste management for distilleries and sugar industries. Designed to comply with the
strictest Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) norms, our innovative solution transforms bio-methanated
concentrated spent wash into a nutrient-rich dry powder that can be reused, sold, or repurposed.
Environmental compliance is at the heart of this technology.

[Read More →][163]
[Spent Wash Dryer]

## Raj MudX – PressMud BioDigester

RAJ MUD X is an innovative CSTR-type biodigester developed by Raj Process Equipments & Systems Pvt.
Ltd., designed specifically to convert sugarcane press mud into renewable biogas.

At the heart of RAJ MUD X lies a Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) equipped with a central
agitator supported by lateral agitators... resulting in faster decomposition rates and optimized
biogas production efficiency.

[Read More →][164]
[Raj MudX – PressMud BioDigester]

## Biogas Upgradation and Purification

At Raj Process Equipments & Systems Pvt. Ltd., we are redefining the future of renewable energy with
our patented biogas upgradation and purification technology.

Our process is based on a multi-stage cleaning and purification technology engineered for maximum
methane recovery and minimal energy consumption.

Backed by Raj Process’s in-house engineering, fabrication, and EPC expertise, our biogas upgradation
plants are fully automated.

[Read More →][165]
[Biogas Upgradation and Purification]

## Non-Clog Extra Long Tube Falling Film Evaporation System

At Raj Process Equipments & Systems Pvt. Ltd., we are proud to introduce our patented Non-Clog Extra
Long Tube Falling Film Evaporation System.

Traditional falling film evaporators often struggle with feedstocks such as distillery spent wash.

This patented technology is widely used in distilleries, sugar mills, agro-residue processing
plants, starch industries, chemicals, and effluent treatment facilities.

### Solutions for Mass and Premium Markets

### About Us

At Ratnakar Spinners, we transform high-grade fibers into world-class yarns and fabrics. Based in
Bhilwara, Rajasthan, our state-of-the-art facilities blend traditional craftsmanship with advanced
automation, enabling production capacities of **14,500 TPA of synthetic yarn** (36,000 spindles).We
serve both domestic and international markets, supplying premium yarn for garments, home textiles,
and technical applications. Our vertically integrated operations from fiber processing to yarn
spinning and dyeing ensure unmatched consistency, traceability, and sustainable quality of yarn.

[More About Us][12]

## Meet Our Chairman

**Mr. Shankar Lal Jat**

A veteran textile entrepreneur, Mr. Jat leads Ratnakar Spinners with a focus on innovation and
premium quality. His industry experience and strategic insights drive the company’s growth and
product development initiatives.

### Why Choose Ratnakar Spinners?

### Manufacturing Strength

Modern plants with double yarn and Compact yarn.

### Quality & Innovation

Precision engineered yarns with 99% quality yield, meeting global standards (ISO, OEKO-TEX).

### Sustainable Practices

Dedicated solar installations and water-recycling systems for greener production.

### Global Reach

Trusted by international brands for on time delivery and customized solutions.

### Customer Focus

Responsive R&D and agile service, from mass market basics to specialized yarns for high end
textiles.

From yarns to timeless textiles begin your journey with Ratnakar Spinners. Learn more about our
mission, team, and product range below.

### Our Board of Directors

Founded in 2021, Ratnakar Spinners Pvt. Ltd. was born from a deep understanding of the textile
industry’s challenges and the opportunity to do things better. At a time when the global supply
chain was being redefined, our founder saw a need for reliable, high-quality, and sustainable
textile manufacturing in India that could serve both domestic and international markets with
integrity and innovation.

#### Mr. Shankar Lal Jat

Director

Mr. Shankar Lal Jat brings decades of experience in the textile industry and leads the company’s
vision with a strong emphasis on innovation, superior product quality, and long-term value creation.
He also serves as a board member in other Ratnakar Group companies, contributing to the overall
strategic alignment of the group.

#### Ms. Prem Devi Jat

Director

Ms. Prem Devi Jat oversees internal operations and financial management. Her leadership strengthens
governance frameworks and ensures the optimal use of resources, contributing to the company’s
operational efficiency and fiscal responsibility.

#### Ms. Geeta Devi Jat

Director

Ms. Geeta Devi Jat is instrumental in promoting a people-first culture. She actively supports
workforce development initiatives, helping to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high-performing
team across the organization.

#### Mr. Rahul Choudhary

Director

Mr. Rahul Choudhary leads business development, marketing, and client engagement. With a modern and
global perspective, he is focused on expanding the company’s digital footprint, strengthening
customer relationships, and driving international growth.

### About Us

At Ratnakar Spinners, we transform high-grade fibers into world-class yarns and fabrics. Based in
Bhilwara, Rajasthan, our state-of-the-art facilities blend traditional craftsmanship with advanced
automation, enabling production capacities of **14,500 TPA of synthetic yarn** (36,000 spindles).We
serve both domestic and international markets, supplying premium yarn for garments, home textiles,
and technical applications. Our vertically integrated operations from fiber processing to yarn
spinning and dyeing ensure unmatched consistency, traceability, and sustainable quality of yarn.

[More About Us][12]

## Meet Our Chairman

**Mr. Shankar Lal Jat**

A veteran textile entrepreneur, Mr. Jat leads Ratnakar Spinners with a focus on innovation and
premium quality. His industry experience and strategic insights drive the company’s growth and
product development initiatives.

### Why Choose Ratnakar Spinners?

### Manufacturing Strength

Modern plants with double yarn and Compact yarn.

### Quality & Innovation

Precision engineered yarns with 99% quality yield, meeting global standards (ISO, OEKO-TEX).

### Sustainable Practices

Dedicated solar installations and water-recycling systems for greener production.

### Global Reach

Trusted by international brands for on time delivery and customized solutions.

### Customer Focus

Responsive R&D and agile service, from mass market basics to specialized yarns for high end
textiles.

From yarns to timeless textiles begin your journey with Ratnakar Spinners. Learn more about our
mission, team, and product range below.

### Our Board of Directors

Founded in 2021, Ratnakar Spinners Pvt. Ltd. was born from a deep understanding of the textile
industry’s challenges and the opportunity to do things better. At a time when the global supply
chain was being redefined, our founder saw a need for reliable, high-quality, and sustainable
textile manufacturing in India that could serve both domestic and international markets with
integrity and innovation.

#### Mr. Shankar Lal Jat

Director

Mr. Shankar Lal Jat brings decades of experience in the textile industry and leads the company’s
vision with a strong emphasis on innovation, superior product quality, and long-term value creation.
He also serves as a board member in other Ratnakar Group companies, contributing to the overall
strategic alignment of the group.

#### Ms. Prem Devi Jat

Director

Ms. Prem Devi Jat oversees internal operations and financial management. Her leadership strengthens
governance frameworks and ensures the optimal use of resources, contributing to the company’s
operational efficiency and fiscal responsibility.

#### Ms. Geeta Devi Jat

Director

Ms. Geeta Devi Jat is instrumental in promoting a people-first culture. She actively supports
workforce development initiatives, helping to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high-performing
team across the organization.

#### Mr. Rahul Choudhary

Director

Mr. Rahul Choudhary leads business development, marketing, and client engagement. With a modern and
global perspective, he is focused on expanding the company’s digital footprint, strengthening
customer relationships, and driving international growth.

## Process Plants Engineered for Sustainability

At Shachi, sustainability is built into every process plant we design. Our solutions improve thermal
efficiency, support heat recovery, reduce energy use, enable water reuse, and help clients move
toward ZLD-ready operations.

We focus on practical, long-term efficiency. This includes the right material selection, modular
upgrade options, intelligent process controls, and data-driven optimisation. These choices help
improve reliability, reduce resource consumption, and lower lifecycle operating costs.

Our commitment to sustainability also goes beyond plant performance. We work to reduce our own
operational footprint across manufacturing, utilities, logistics, and infrastructure. For us,
sustainability is not a one-time initiative. It is a measurable and ongoing responsibility.

# Product **Category**

seawater desalination
Pharmaceutical Water
ZLD
Oil and gas field produced

### seawater desalination system

This seawater desalination equipment is an integrated, mobile water production solution that
incorporates a complete high-efficiency reverse osmosis system into a standard container. The
equipment undergoes full prefabrication, assembly, and testing in the factory; upon arrival at the
site, it can be rapidly commissioned with just basic electrical and water connections, achieving
"instant readiness for use and immediate water production." Specifically designed for emergency
water supply, temporary operations, remote areas, and rapid deployment scenarios, it combines the
processing capacity of industrial-scale equipment with the flexibility and convenience of modular
systems, making it an ideal solution for short-term or permanent decentralized water supply needs.

[View More ][16]
[Products Categories1]

### Pharmaceutical Water system

This pharmaceutical-grade water system is designed for pharmaceutical enterprises, formulation
workshops, and API production lines. It uses a proven process—pretreatment, precision filtration,
RO, and EDI—to produce high-quality purified water reliably. Compliant with pharmaceutical
engineering standards, the system supports online monitoring, validation, and operational safety for
continuous production. Its modular, highly automated design enables real-time tracking of
conductivity, temperature, and flow rate, ensuring stable water quality and traceable data. The
system meets core industry requirements: controllable, monitorable, and verifiable.

[View More ][17]

### ZLD system

This high-salinity wastewater reduction system is specifically designed for treating high-salinity
wastewater. Utilizing advanced evaporation and crystallization technologies, it achieves significant
wastewater reduction and substantially lowers treatment costs. The system is suitable for industries
such as chemical, pharmaceutical, and electroplating. Featuring fully automated operation, low
energy consumption, and compact footprint, it effortlessly achieves near-zero liquid discharge. With
its stable and durable performance, the system assists enterprises in complying with regulatory
standards and transitioning toward green production.

[View More ][18]

### Oil and gas field produced water treatment system

The system employs a comprehensive treatment process combining oil removal, softening, DTRO
(Dissolved Total Oxygen Removal), and concentration. The treated reinjected water contains ≤5 mg/L
oil and ≤1 mg/L suspended solids, enabling zero-discharge reuse of fracturing Discharge fluid.
Designed as a skid-mound  container unit, it achieves rapid commissioning within 15 days with
intelligent unmanned operation and remote monitoring. Compatible with harsh environments such as
those in the Middle East and Kazakhstan, this solution ensures effortless compliance with regulatory
standards.

[View More ][19]

### seawater desalination system

This seawater desalination equipment is an integrated, mobile water production solution that
incorporates a complete high-efficiency reverse osmosis system into a standard container. The
equipment undergoes full prefabrication, assembly, and testing in the factory; upon arrival at the
site, it can be rapidly commissioned with just basic electrical and water connections, achieving
"instant readiness for use and immediate water production." Specifically designed for emergency
water supply, temporary operations, remote areas, and rapid deployment scenarios, it combines the
processing capacity of industrial-scale equipment with the flexibility and convenience of modular
systems, making it an ideal solution for short-term or permanent decentralized water supply needs.

[View More ][16]
[Products Categories1]

### Pharmaceutical Water system

This pharmaceutical-grade water system is designed for pharmaceutical enterprises, formulation
workshops, and API production lines. It uses a proven process—pretreatment, precision filtration,
RO, and EDI—to produce high-quality purified water reliably. Compliant with pharmaceutical
engineering standards, the system supports online monitoring, validation, and operational safety for
continuous production. Its modular, highly automated design enables real-time tracking of
conductivity, temperature, and flow rate, ensuring stable water quality and traceable data. The
system meets core industry requirements: controllable, monitorable, and verifiable.

[View More ][17]

### ZLD system

This high-salinity wastewater reduction system is specifically designed for treating high-salinity
wastewater. Utilizing advanced evaporation and crystallization technologies, it achieves significant
wastewater reduction and substantially lowers treatment costs. The system is suitable for industries
such as chemical, pharmaceutical, and electroplating. Featuring fully automated operation, low
energy consumption, and compact footprint, it effortlessly achieves near-zero liquid discharge. With
its stable and durable performance, the system assists enterprises in complying with regulatory
standards and transitioning toward green production.

[View More ][18]

### Oil and gas field produced water treatment system

The system employs a comprehensive treatment process combining oil removal, softening, DTRO
(Dissolved Total Oxygen Removal), and concentration. The treated reinjected water contains ≤5 mg/L
oil and ≤1 mg/L suspended solids, enabling zero-discharge reuse of fracturing Discharge fluid.
Designed as a skid-mound  container unit, it achieves rapid commissioning within 15 days with
intelligent unmanned operation and remote monitoring. Compatible with harsh environments such as
those in the Middle East and Kazakhstan, this solution ensures effortless compliance with regulatory
standards.

# Efficiency in Energy and Water

TAPROGGE is a world leader in industrial cleaning technology and is headquartered in the town of
Wetter in the Ruhr region of Germany. For more than 60 years, we have focused on helping our
customers to achieve greater efficiencies when generating power while also helping them to protect
the environment.

We have delivered over 18,000 systems to customers all over the world who receive excellent customer
service through our 10 subsidiaries and 60 international sales agents. We are continually expanding
our business which encompasses the following areas:

## [ Maximizing Energy and Water Efficiency in Power Stations and Industrial Applications ][21]

[

We optimize cooling water systems in power stations and industrial applications by using end-to-end
solutions for water extraction, filtration and condenser tube cleaning.

][22]

## [ Maximizing Energy and Water Efficiency in Seawater Desalination ][23]

[

TAPROGGE uses a wide range of innovative and environmentally friendly desalination concepts and
tried-and-tested technology to deliver highly effective filtration and tube cleaning solutions.

][24]

## [ Fluid Concentration & Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) ][25]

[

The subject of reducing waste water volumes, right up to complete elimination of waste water, is one
of the major tasks in the fight against water shortages and conservation of resources.

][26]

## [ Water Recycling and Resource Recovery ][27]

[

Efficient liquid-solid separation, waste reduction and the recycling of valuable resources protect
the environment and provide added value for operators.

][28]

## [ Efficient use of industrial heat pumps with TAPROGGE technology ][29]

[

Efficient heat transfer in the evaporator significantly reduces energy consumption. This conserves
resources, contributes to achieving your sustainability goals and also reduces your operating costs.

][30]

### Efficiency and sustainability

All areas of the TAPROGGE business focus on making processes even more efficient. We are one of only
a few companies in the world that produce these kinds of solutions which protect the environment,
conserve resources whilst reducing production costs.

For example, using TAPROGGE systems can result in annual energy savings which equate to around 20
million tonnes of coal. If this amount of coal were loaded onto a goods train, it would be 3,600
kilometres long, which is roughly the distance from Helsinki to Athens.

Fouling problems cost power plant operators around the world USD 45.02 billion per year. We aim to
significantly reduce these costs whilst reducing the burden on the environment to the high degree
outlined above.

### Efficiency and sustainability

All areas of the TAPROGGE business focus on making processes even more efficient. We are one of only
a few companies in the world that produce these kinds of solutions which protect the environment,
conserve resources whilst reducing production costs.

million tonnes of coal. If this amount of coal were loaded onto a goods train, it would be 3,600
kilometres long, which is roughly the distance from Helsinki to Athens.

Fouling problems cost power plant operators around the world USD 45.02 billion per year. We aim to
significantly reduce these costs whilst reducing the burden on the environment to the high degree
outlined above.

### About Company

Trity Environ Solutions is a leading [**STP & ETP plant manufacturer in India**][19], specializing
in Sewage Treatment Plants, Effluent Treatment Plants, and advanced Wastewater Treatment Solutions
for industrial and commercial sectors. We manufacture and supply high-quality Wastewater Treatment
Plants, Industrial Filters, MBBR Media, Tube Settler Media, and Air Pollution Control Equipment
designed to meet environmental standards and regulatory compliance.

Along with manufacturing, we provide expert consultancy services in wastewater treatment plant
design, installation, operation, and environmental compliance. Our team ensures reliable and
efficient solutions tailored to the needs of industries, housing societies, builders, and government
projects.

We take pride in offering 24×7 customer support across PAN India. Our experts provide operational
training and technical guidance to clients for effective plant management. We also conduct training
programs and share educational resources to keep our clients updated with the latest technologies in
wastewater treatment and environmental sustainability.

# Welcome to UCC Environmental

Since 1920, UCC Environmental has provided highly engineered environmental solutions worldwide for
power generation, mining, steel, and other heavy industrial applications. Our mission is to innovate
and deliver reliable air pollution control, water and[ wastewater treatment][173], and solids
handling systems that meet each customer’s unique needs. We believe in the power of collaboration,
working closely with our customers and partners to conceptualize, design, and supply systems
tailored to their specific requirements.

Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our core values of innovation and exceptional customer
service. These principles guide us in every project, ensuring that we not only meet but exceed our
customers’ expectations throughout the life of their systems.

Headquartered in Illinois, USA, UCC Environmental supports a global network with over 50 sales and
service locations worldwide. Our operations in the United States, Germany, India, and China enable
us to seamlessly serve our international customer base, providing the highest level of support and
expertise.

At UCC Environmental, we are driven by a vision of a sustainable future. We continuously strive to
develop solutions that address current environmental challenges and anticipate and adapt to future
needs. Our dedication to environmental stewardship and customer satisfaction is at the heart of
everything we do.

*Innovating Today for a Sustainable Tomorrow!*

[Learn More About UCC Environmental][174]
